outcome: successful delivery of a healthy neonate
prevention of maternofetal morbidity and mortality
cohort: The study involved a single pregnant patient diagnosed with acquired thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura (TTP) who was refractory to therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) and high-dose corticosteroids.
finding: Off-label use of caplacizumab in a pregnant patient with refractory acquired TTP resulted in hematologic recovery and the successful delivery of a healthy neonate.
